unchanged: Price/DDV/trend/RS eligibility and structural biotech exclusion
strict leave-one-out Theme score in ATTACK and Stock RS189 in SELECTIVE
-8% close stop, +24% first 25% partial, Peak Close -30% trail, Red next-open exit
no forced trim when ATTACK falls to SELECTIVE
design.core_proxy: eligible and (20d-average dollar volume >= $100,000,000 OR cross-sectional dollar-volume percentile >= 85)
design.enhanced_core_score: 60% current V38 rank + 25% RS63 + 15% DDV percentile
design.enhanced_emerging_score: 50% current V38 rank + 20% RS63 + 15% 20d RS63 acceleration percentile + 10% 20d return percentile + 5% DDV acceleration percentile
design.capacity: layer targets gate only new entries; existing positions are never force-trimmed; unused layer capacity may spill after both layers had the opportunity to fill
design.selective_default: 4 Core / 0 Emerging; one robustness variant tests 3 Core / 1 Emerging

leader_denominators.note: Core/Emerging size is proxied by contemporaneous liquidity, not historical market cap; no current market-cap look-ahead is used.

caveats: Leader labels are ex-post audit denominators only; no future data enters signals.
Historical market cap/share-count series are not used because coverage is not sufficiently reliable across the full universe; dollar-volume scale is the size/market-leadership proxy.
Theme taxonomy is the research-branch taxonomy and can contain classification look-ahead; strict leave-one-out prevents self-influence but does not fully remove taxonomy look-ahead.
Yahoo OHLCV/universe survivorship and delisting coverage can under-represent historical delisted stocks.
Transaction-cost sensitivity uses 10 bps on each buy/sell cash flow; taxes and slippage beyond that are not modeled.
